subject: CFG-1228: which environment drifted on a uniform key
body:
Hi, Fatima Zahra from the data team here. Please audit the
ledger-api configs for drift: find the environment whose
copy sets a must-be-uniform key differently from the rest,
and name the key.

Keys that may legitimately vary (hosts, replicas, log
levels) are listed in config/POLICY.md and do not count.
Ignore the security keys for this question; they are a
separate audit.

Thanks, Fatima Zahra
